title: Free evidence drills: backup restore, crash recovery, device checklist
problem: Backups, crash recovery and real-device behaviour have no evidence yet (the free half of PLAN-003).
scope: Export and restore drill for the online room data (Durable Objects) on the preview server, with the steps written down
Room crash-recovery test: stop a room mid-game and check players can continue
A real-device checklist (set-up, a full game, an online room, rotate, background and resume) as a one-page sheet for the phones the owner has
Live smoke test run from CI against the preview
exclusions: Touching the live game or live data

acceptance.text: A room restored from an export continues the game it held
After a forced room restart both players can continue the same game
The device checklist is run on at least two real phones and results are recorded
The preview smoke test passes in CI
